summary:
Phase 49 (Fees — reminders, day book, receipt PDFs) fully verified. Backend pytest: tests/test_phase49.py 5/5 PASS + tests/test_phase48.py 7/7 PASS (regression) + new tests/test_phase49_live.py 8/8 PASS against live LPGS. UI acceptance on real LPGS (admin + parent) all green. No bugs found.

LIVE API RESULTS:
(1) GET /api/fees/day-book?date=2026-10-12 (admin) → summary.total=5000, count=1; by_method UPI ₹5,000; by_class Grade 8 ₹5,000; by_collector LPGS SCHOOL ADMIN ₹5,000. Bad date '12-12' → 400. teacher (prasad27) and parent (parent.demo) → 403.
(2) GET /api/fees/payments/{Fathima}/receipt.pdf: admin→200 %PDF…%%EOF (132793 bytes), parent.demo→200 own child, parent.demo→403 for Haritha's receipt, teacher→403.
(3) POST /api/fees/reminders/run, POST /api/fees/reminders/class, PUT /api/fees/reminder-settings → 403 for teacher and parent tokens.
(4) GET /api/public/fee-link/<bad token> → 400. GET /api/fees/reminder-settings (admin) → 200 with enabled/before_days/overdue_after_days/repeat_every_days fields.

UI RESULTS (admin@lpgs.com):
- /app/fees header 'Reminders' btn (fee-reminder-settings-btn) opens fee-reminder-settings-dialog with fee-reminder-enabled=checked, before_days=3, overdue_after_days=1, repeat_every_days=7. Closed without saving (defaults preserved).
- Day Book tab (fees-tab-daybook): date 2026-10-12 shows daybook-total ₹5,000, daybook-count 1, daybook-reversed '1 · ₹100 — LPGS-2026-000002', by_method UPI × 1 ₹5,000, by_collector 'LPGS SCHOOL ADMIN × 1 ₹5,000', by_class 'Grade 8 × 1 ₹5,000'; daybook-row-LPGS-2026-000001 present; daybook-print button present.
- Receipts tab: fee-receipt-pdf-LPGS-2026-000001 downloads receipt-LPGS-2026-000001.pdf (132793 bytes, %PDF…%%EOF).
- Accounts tab (fees-tab-accounts): fee-accounts-class is a native <select>; after selecting Grade 8 → 3 account rows + fee-remind-class-btn present (NOT clicked). Opening a ledger shows 4 fee-remind-<period> bell buttons.
- Bad-token page /fees/invoice/bad_token_xyz: fee-link-error 'This link is invalid or has expired' present.

UI RESULTS (parent.demo@lpgs.com):
- Child switcher → Fathima Jyothi (Grade 8-A) chip activates; parent-fees-toggle expands; Receipts row has 1 pdf icon (parent-fees-receipt-pdf-<paymentId>) that downloads a real 132793-byte PDF (%PDF…%%EOF), filename receipt-LPGS-2026-000001.pdf.

NO MUTATIONS on LPGS: did NOT PUT reminder settings, did NOT POST /remind, did NOT click fee-remind-class-btn or any per-period bell. WhatsApp quota and messages collection untouched.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now exceeds 12k lines; the Phase 48/49 fees block (~1k lines, including reminders sweep + loop, day-book, PDF builder) should be extracted to backend/fees.py — the on_event startup also starts the reminder loop here, which is additional reason to isolate.
FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'|'shutdown') still used (deprecated) — pending migration to lifespan handlers (long-standing).
fee-accounts-class is a native <select> while most other filter dropdowns in the app are shadcn Select; cosmetic inconsistency (works fine, just UX disparity).

success_rate.backend: 100% (5/5 phase49 unit + 7/7 phase48 regression + 8/8 phase49 live)

seed_data_creation: None on live LPGS. Unit tests use throwaway DB lnmo_phase49_test (auto-dropped).

For UI test of Fathima's fees in parent portal, use child chip parent-child-f0cd611d-fb73-40fc-9829-6996460e4de4 (clicking by data-testid alone doesn't fire — use get_by_text('Fathima Jyothi').click(force=True) OR the parent-child-switcher wrapper).
